data.title: Reminder: Failed Direct Debit for 2026 Family Membership Fee
data.summary: Sportverein Beispielau 1911 e.V. informs Johanna Beispielacker that the direct debit for the 2026 family membership fee failed and was returned by her bank. The club asks for a transfer of €172.50 (the €168.00 annual fee plus a €4.50 return-debit fee) by 3 December 2026.
data.explanation: Your sports club's attempt to collect the 2026 family membership fee by direct debit (SEPA-Lastschrift) failed and was sent back by your bank, likely due to insufficient funds, a closed account, or a cancelled mandate. You now owe both the original fee and a bank return-fee charged by the club. Please transfer €172.50 to the club's account by 3 December 2026 using the IBAN given. If your bank details changed, send the club a new SEPA mandate to avoid this happening again. If you don't pay, the club may send further reminders or escalate collection.
